summary: The SDK has a Quick Look panel data model (items, clamped index, step, toggle, close) and a thumbnail path cache, but the shell does not draw the floating panel and apps get no view, extension or data-based preview API. Files has its own in-app previews for text, image, audio, PDF, folder and info cards.

features.apple: QLPreviewPanel: shared(), dataSource, reloadData(), refreshCurrentPreviewItem(), currentController
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/peek.rs (PreviewPanel: set_items, step, toggle, reload_data, make_key_and_order_front, close, handle_key); springboard/proto/src/peek.rs (ToShell::Preview 0x1e0, PreviewClose 0x1e1); wired: springboard/src/shell/preview_panel.rs
features.note: The SDK sends the list and close messages, refresh_current_item re-sends the list, and handle_key maps the arrows, Space and Escape to the panel's step, toggle and close; the shell draws the panel (wired in 0.5.41). Headless tests: sdk/tests/parity_sdk-complete-11.rs (the_arrow_keys_step_through_the_list_without_wrapping, space_and_escape_are_handed_back_without_moving_the_index). Gap: there is no process-wide shared() panel, which the shell's single floating panel makes unnecessary, and no controller responder chain; the drawn panel and key delivery need a check on Midget.

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/peek.rs (re-exports PreviewItem from proto); springboard/proto/src/peek.rs (PreviewItem::new, file_name)
features.note: URL and title are carried (URL cut to 256 bytes, title to 96, at most 16 items), PreviewItem::new builds one and file_name names the file of a file URL. Headless tests: sdk/tests/parity_sdk-complete-11.rs (a_file_item_names_its_file_and_other_urls_name_none). The display state is kept per item by the panel and the embedded view rather than on the item, and percent escapes in file URLs are not decoded.

The panel pulls its items from a PreviewDataSource (at most 16) through load_from and keeps a display state per item, reset by a new list. Headless tests: sdk/tests/parity_sdk-tests-01a.rs (panel_pulls_a_data_source_and_stops_at_the_item_cap, panel_display_state_is_kept_per_item_and_reset_by_a_new_list) and sdk/tests/parity_sdk-complete-11.rs (a_panel_pulls_its_items_from_a_source_and_keeps_states_per_item). Gap: there are no delegate callbacks, lazy loading block or transition source frame, because the shell does not report panel events back to the app yet.

features.apple: QLPreviewView: init(frame:style:), previewItem, refreshPreviewItem(), displayState, autostarts, close
features.note: The model holds the item, its display state, the autostart and close-with-window switches, the refresh count and a settable style. Headless tests: sdk/tests/parity_sdk-tests-01a.rs (embedded_view_loads_an_autostarting_item_until_the_app_reports_ready, embedded_view_without_autostart_waits_at_ready, embedded_view_closes_with_its_window_only_when_asked) and sdk/tests/parity_sdk-complete-11.rs (changing_the_style_of_an_embedded_view_keeps_its_item_and_state). Gap: the preview is a Files-owned page, not a view an app can place in its own hierarchy, and drawing it needs a check on Midget.

features.feature: Built-in previews for common file types
features.apple: Quick Look generates previews for common file types (text, images, audio, video, PDF, documents)
features.bifrost: springboard/src/files/preview.rs (preview_for, line 28: text, image, audio card, video, PDF, folder summary, info card); springboard/src/files/mod.rs (spawn_preview: PDF text via the Books engine)
features.note: The preview choice by file type, text wrapping and picture size checks are tested headless in springboard/tests/parity_sdk-tests-16.rs. Only the Files app uses these. The SDK offers no built-in renderer, so other apps get nothing unless they render thumbnails themselves.

features.apple: QLThumbnailGenerator: request, update handlers, multiple representations
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/thumbnails.rs (request, reply, event, load_pixels, GeneratorRequest, Generation, Generation::cancel); springboard/ui/src/thumb_service.rs
features.note: The SDK keeps no cache: the shell's thumbnails service draws and caches each picture and the app reads the reply or event. GeneratorRequest plans the icon, low-quality and thumbnail representations, and Generation hands each better one to the update handler once; cancel stops accepting replies. Headless tests: sdk/tests/parity_sdk-tests-01a.rs (a_thumbnail_answer_names_its_cached_picture, a_thumbnail_event_is_read_only_from_its_own_service) and sdk/tests/parity_sdk-complete-11.rs (a_generation_delivers_each_wanted_representation_and_finishes_at_the_best, cancelling_a_generation_refuses_every_later_answer). Gap: cancel does not stop the shell's own draw, and the real pictures need a check on Midget.

features.apple: Arrow keys and panel navigation through the data source; Space toggles the panel
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/peek.rs (step, toggle, handle_key); springboard/src/files/mod.rs (step_preview, line 438: previous or next file in the folder)
features.note: Files steps through its folder without wrapping, and PreviewPanel::handle_key steps the SDK panel with Left and Right without wrapping, returning Space and Escape for the app to toggle or close. Headless tests: sdk/tests/parity_sdk-tests-01a.rs (panel_steps_through_the_list_without_wrapping) and sdk/tests/parity_sdk-complete-11.rs (the_arrow_keys_step_through_the_list_without_wrapping). Gap: the shell does not route the panel's keys yet, so focus and key delivery need a check on Midget.

The model routes a file by its type and a searchable item by its longest matching domain, and unregister removes a provider with its types and domains. Headless tests: ui/tests/parity_sdk-tests-01a.rs (a_narrow_searchable_domain_beats_a_broader_one, file_subjects_must_name_an_absolute_file, searchable_subjects_drop_a_blank_query) and ui/tests/parity_sdk-complete-11.rs (unregistering_a_provider_removes_its_types_and_domains). Gap: no app registration reaches the shell and no searchable item preview is drawn; both need the shell side and a check on Midget.

Providers run in this process: a Reply validates HTML with inline attachments, PDF page sizes, bitmap sizes and file replies, and Registry::preview calls the provider the registry picks. Headless tests: ui/tests/parity_sdk-tests-01a.rs (preview_reply_rejects_bitmaps_outside_the_edge_limit, html_attachments_need_unique_usable_ids, nearer_registration_beats_an_ancestor_and_ties_go_to_the_first, preview_calls_the_provider_the_registry_picked) and ui/tests/parity_sdk-complete-11.rs (a_pdf_reply_keeps_its_page_size_and_refuses_an_empty_page). Gap: no out-of-process extension returns data, PDF or HTML replies to the shell, which needs the extension host and a check on Midget. Wired into the UI in wiring wave 3 (0.5.39); verify on Midget for parity.

gaps: The shell does not draw the Quick Look panel: ToShell::Preview and PreviewClose are decoded and ignored (springboard/proto/src/lib.rs:677-679).
No app-facing preview extension point: no equivalent of QLPreviewingController or QLPreviewProvider.
No embeddable preview view (QLPreviewView) in the SDK.
The SDK has no built-in file renderers for QLThumbnailGenerator; each app renders its own thumbnails.
No thumbnail update handlers or multi-representation requests.
No panel data source or delegate protocol, no lazy loading block, and no display state for items.
The Files Quick Look menu item is not in springboard/apps/files/src/main.rs: the index returned a MENU_QUICK_LOOK constant there, but a grep of the current file finds none.
